backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin and public types for render rules and Genesis Craft previews.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related frontend files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend source files for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes with base border/background styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application container defining project types, view routing, persistent storage logic, and global dialogs.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions using alert-dialog components and a shared store.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer with attribution and a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive navigation header with project context, save-status display, and mobile menu handling.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Lightweight hover/focus tooltip component with positioned popover and arrow indicator.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog component explaining how to obtain a Pinata JWT token, including warnings and step-by-step guidance.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Small UI component that displays save status text based on a given state without causing layout shift.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Control panel for locking, unlocking, and uploading NFT collections to IPFS with state handling and progress updates.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle UI that switches between compact and grid display modes in the vault view.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Zustand-powered confirmation dialog logic exposing a promise-based confirm function for destructive actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing authentication state, login, logout, and persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Debounced hook that validates a Pinata JWT token and returns status and messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling with Apple-inspired color system, motion settings, utilities, and component styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and InternetIdentity providers and renders App.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Provides UI for assembling tokens, uploading trait images, and rendering live previews based on selected traits.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Displays all projects and supports creating, editing settings, opening, and deleting projects.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Generates token previews by merging selected traits, validates rule compliance, and supports random trait shuffling.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Allows adjusting and normalizing trait rarity weights per layer with auto‑initialization and proportional updates.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of trait‑compatibility rules for a project.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: React page for editing project settings, including Pinata API keys, metadata format, blockchain sync, and Solana creator management with validation.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Manages NFT generation, viewing, filtering, sorting, and exporting, including a custom ZIP creator and web worker message handling.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Provides UI for managing layers and traits, including adding, deleting, renaming, reordering, and maintaining rule integrity.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading NFT images and metadata to Pinata, converting image data, tracking progress, and returning IPFS CIDs.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Generates preview and final metadata for NFTs based on settings, supporting Solana, Ethereum, and ICP formats with optional IPFS URIs.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Implements simple last-write-wins project persistence in localStorage with legacy cleanup and storage size helpers.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Provides helpers to validate a Pinata JWT and upload files, JSON, or directories to IPFS via Pinata APIs.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines message types, data models, and type guards for communication between the UI and the NFT generator worker.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Offers a utility to yield control to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive during long tasks.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Implements a worker that generates NFTs, handles trait rules, DNA uniqueness, and optional OffscreenCanvas image compositing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, spacing, typography, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s feature inventory, versioned state, and a summary of planned UI/UX optimization scope.
